newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: BES to maintain dividend policy.
newsitem.headline: BES to maintain dividend policy.

text.p: Portugal's Banco Espirito Santo (BES) will maintain its policy of distributing at least 50 percent of its profits as dividends to shareholders, bank president Ricardo Espirito Santo Salgado said.
"The policy of distributing at least 50 percent of results is central to the bank and will continue," he told Reuters.
BES has proposed a dividend on its 1996 results of 131.6 escudos per share, up from 114.5 the previous year.
He said the bank would focus on organic growth which would benefit shareholders.
"If we followed a growth pattern of acquisitions I'm sure from what I've seen that our shareholders would be penalized," Salgado said.
BES earlier reported it had raised its 1996 consolidated net profit 21.3 percent to 23.59 billion escudos.
